hollis — Apple Intelligence from the terminal, via macOS Shortcuts.

hollis sends a prompt to Apple Intelligence (cloud, cloud-pro, on-device, or
chatgpt) through a bridge shortcut invoked with /usr/bin/shortcuts, and
returns plain text. Prompts come from arguments or stdin, so shell pipelines
and agents drive it. Persistent chats are stored in local SQLite and replayed
each turn. Image generation uses a separate explicit Shortcut and saves a PNG:
run 'hollis image generate --help' for setup and limits.

Model tiers: run 'hollis models' to see what resolves on this machine
(cloud-pro is macOS 27+). Bridge shortcuts are resolved at runtime:
config override > installed name; a compiled placeholder UUID is retained only
as an unverified candidate ('hollis config set bridge <tier> <name-or-uuid>'
to override).
Default model: auto (cloud first, then one on-device fallback only for an
unavailable bridge). Provider limits never retry or fall back.
Agent mode: add --agent to supported data commands for JSON output + non-interactive mode.
Native local: --model local uses the Foundation Models SDK on Apple Silicon/macOS 27;
human terminal output streams, JSON/agent output stays complete.
'hollis "Explain closures"' means 'hollis respond "Explain closures"' and
accepts respond's flags. Use respond or -- to send literal command-like text.
Command parsing rules: https://github.com/kamenxrider/hollis/blob/main/docs/cli.md#prompt-or-command
Health check: run 'hollis doctor' to verify the transport and bridges.
Local OpenAI-compatible endpoint: run 'hollis serve' (127.0.0.1:1978).
Recipes: https://github.com/kamenxrider/hollis/blob/main/README.md
Report issues: https://github.com/kamenxrider/hollis/issues

Usage:
  hollis [flags]
  hollis [command]

Available Commands:
  agent-context Emit structured JSON describing this CLI for agents
  batch         Plan and run a finite, resumable input folder
  benchmark     Measure native Local speed with fixed prompts
  chat          Persistent chat: one-shot via argument/stdin, or interactive in a terminal
  chats         Inspect persistent chats (list, search, show, rename, delete)
  completion    Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  config        Inspect or change persisted defaults
  doctor        Check transport health: shortcuts CLI, bridge shortcuts, settings
  examples      Print copyable recipes organized by job; never execute them
  help          Help about any command
  image         Experimental image generation through an explicit bridge
  mcp           Configure and inspect MCP servers
  models        List the selectable model tiers and what maps to what
  respond       Send one prompt to Apple Intelligence and print the plain-text response
  serve         Serve the local OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint
  setup         Plan route setup, or explicitly open bundled Shortcut imports
  update        Check for a newer stable release; upgrade Homebrew only with --apply
  version       Print version

Flags:
      --agent           Set all agent-friendly defaults (--json --no-input)
  -h, --help            help for hollis
      --json            Output as JSON
      --no-input        Disable all interactive prompts (for CI/agents)
  -q, --quiet           Hide notes, hints and progress on stderr; never hide errors or the answer
      --select string   Comma-separated fields to include in JSON output (e.g. --select response)
      --version         Print the Hollis version

Use "hollis [command] --help" for more information about a command.

Examples:
  hollis examples
  hollis respond "Explain closures in Go in three sentences"
  hollis respond "Summarize this document" --file notes.md
  printf 'Explain a race condition' | hollis respond
  hollis chat
  hollis chat --continue <id> "And the downside?"
  hollis respond --code "Write a Go function that reverses a slice" > reverse.go
  hollis respond --model local --schema person.json "Invent one person"
  hollis doctor
  hollis benchmark --runs 3
  hollis serve --token-file hollis.token

Environment:
  HOLLIS_STATE_DIR  absolute state directory (default: ~/Library/Application Support/hollis)
  HOLLIS_API_TOKEN  bearer token for hollis serve (alternative to --token-file)
  HOLLIS_MODEL      respond/new text chat default: positional model > --model > environment > saved model > built-in
  HOLLIS_TIMEOUT    respond/chat/image generate duration: --timeout > environment > saved timeout > command default; batch and HTTP unchanged

Exit codes:
  0   success
  1   unexpected internal error
  2   usage error: bad flag, unknown model, empty prompt, near-miss command refusal, or invalid arguments
  3   missing resource: unknown conversation, no search hits, a bridge that is not installed, or no code to print with --code
  5   discovery, transport, Shortcut or native failure, declined request, or rate limit
  7   the run exceeded its deadline
  10  config or database error
